meta.source: verstack.ai live CSS (home and product-visual tokens, read 16 Nov 2026) + VerstackAI/verstack-mvp apps/web/src/styles.css (auth hero, scan gradient) + apps/design-system/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (motion, app type). Website wins where sources disagree. Line-drawing system added 17 Nov 2026 from the reference set (spec sheets, exploded views, annotated plans).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Frame background. Dark: hero, video, LinkedIn graphics, email header and footer. Light: story panels and the email body panel.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: A surface sitting on bg: a stat card on the ground, a white card on a light panel.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on bg. 16.8:1 on dark, 12.5:1 on light.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and meta on bg. Dark value is the site's white at 76% flattened onto the ground (10:1); light value is 4.9:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta lines, callout keys and title-bar text on bg and tile. 5.3:1 on dark bg, 4.9:1 on light bg.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Spec-sheet tiles that hold one drawing and a dot label, sitting on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and tile strokes. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Light button on the ground, black button on a light panel.

tokens.name: action-fg
tokens.usage: Primary button label.

tokens.name: action-line
tokens.usage: Outline (secondary) button border. Site value on dark: white at 72%.

tokens.name: ground-950
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: verstack.ai body and browser theme colour, email outer canvas, video letterbox.

tokens.name: ground-900
tokens.usage: THE ground (--home-dark, --auth-hero-dark). Hero, story bands, video frames, LinkedIn graphics.

tokens.name: ground-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface on the ground (--home-dark-raised).

tokens.name: ground-photo
tokens.usage: Tile fill while a photo loads, and the tile colour in motion work (--auth-hero-photo-surface).

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Hero veil base colour. Used left to right at the opacities in the Veil family so copy sits on the dark end.

tokens.name: scene-900
tokens.usage: Dark product UI card inside explainers (--pv-ink, --home-scene-dark).

tokens.name: scene-800
tokens.usage: Raised element inside a dark product UI card (--home-scene-dark-raised).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Light panel and white text on the ground (Lime Mist in the app system).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Quiet light surface (--home-surface).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Muted chip and divider on light (--home-surface-muted). Fill of the Rolling out status pill.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Text on light panels (--home-ink).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text on light panels (--home-muted). 4.9:1 on mist.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Very large titles on light (the data plate's one-word title).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Text on lime. Black button on light.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White card on a light panel.

tokens.name: lime-electric
tokens.usage: THE accent. One lime part per drawing (its top face), the Live dot, the callout node for that part. Never as text on light (1.2:1). Text on lime is black (16.5:1).

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Lime part: the face towards the viewer's left. End stop of the website scan gradient.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias. Use this name in new work so the accent can move without a hunt.

tokens.name: scan-1
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 0% (top).

tokens.name: scan-2
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 12%.

tokens.name: scan-3
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 26%.

tokens.name: scan-4
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 42%.

tokens.name: scan-5
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 58%.

tokens.name: scan-6
tokens.usage: Lime part: the face to the viewer's right. Scan gradient stop 74% (website only).

tokens.name: scan-7
tokens.usage: Scan gradient stop 100% (bottom). The gradient runs top to bottom, fully opaque, and replaces the photo under it rather than tinting it.

tokens.name: ui-destructive
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: an error or over-budget state. Never decoration.

tokens.name: ui-success
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: approved or done.

tokens.name: ui-success-bg
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: success chip fill.

tokens.name: ui-warning
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: needs attention.

tokens.name: ui-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: warning chip fill.

tokens.name: ui-caution
tokens.usage: Product UI mockups only: status dot for Review.

styles.name: graphic-headline
styles.usage: The headline on a graphic, sized to fill its space: two to four balanced lines. 104px is the starting point on a 1080-wide frame; go bigger if it still fits.

styles.name: plate-title
styles.usage: The one-word title on a light data plate, in ink-900.

styles.name: callout-name
styles.usage: Callout name: bold pop-up text beside the part it points at. Two callouts per frame at most.

styles.name: data-row
styles.usage: Stage text on a data plate row. The unit name above it is 44px at weight 600.

styles.name: callout-line
styles.usage: The one line under a callout name, in ink-500 or fg-muted. 28px is the smallest text allowed on any graphic or video frame.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page or graphic. Measured from the verstack.ai h1 (63.3px, -3.48px tracking).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section and story-panel headline. Measured from the verstack.ai h2.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and feature titles in explainers and emails.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Verstack speeds up unit turns, lowers costs and keeps maintenance running around the clock.
styles.usage: The one sentence under a headline. Site measure: 16.8px / 26px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Verstack checks the unit's repair history and budget before work starts.
styles.usage: Paragraphs in emails, carousels and explainers.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Site measure: 15.2px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meta lines and status pills. Sentence case, no positive tracking.

styles.name: video-title
styles.usage: Title card. Max two lines. Scale by frame height: x0.75 for 1080 x 1350, x1.0 for 1080 x 1920.

styles.name: video-headline
styles.usage: Scene headline on the dark beside a card. Fitted to its column: the largest size that keeps every word inside, two to four balanced lines.

styles.name: video-caption
styles.sample: The manager approves it from her phone.
styles.usage: Burned-in caption. Max 2 lines, 42 characters a line.

styles.name: video-label
styles.usage: The smallest text on a frame: a status word or the URL on the end card.

styles.name: video-support
styles.sample: Every floor and unit keeps its own history.
styles.usage: One supporting line under a scene headline, in fg-muted, sitting just above the lockup.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Inside product cards only, matching the app's IBM Plex Sans.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Unit 214 · Mill Court · Waiting on approval
styles.usage: Inside product cards only.

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Chips and meta inside product cards only.

styles.name: email-headline
styles.sample: Repeat repairs get flagged before anyone books a trade.
styles.usage: Release email headline. Pixel tracking because some clients ignore em.

styles.name: email-body
styles.sample: Verstack now checks the unit's history first.
styles.usage: Release email paragraphs and steps.

styles.name: email-meta
styles.usage: Label line, footer, status pill.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base step (shared with the app system).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its lead in small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Product card padding (site: 16px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, email side padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Email panel padding, gap between story blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Graphic inner margin at 1080 wide.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Graphic outer margin at 1080 x 1350.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Video safe margin at 1920 x 1080 (5%).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small chips inside product cards.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: App-sized controls shown in mockups.

tokens.name: radius-ui-card
tokens.usage: Dark product UI card (site .pv-surface).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Photo and scan tiles, marketing buttons (56px tall on site), email cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large light panel or feature tile (site .home-report-flow-card). Use 24px inside 600px emails.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills.

duration.note: From the app system and the hero CSS, except where a usage note says it is a marketing rule.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: App: hover and state changes in UI mockups.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: App: panel and label reveals in UI mockups.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Marketing rule: a headline or card arriving (rise 16px and fade).

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: Marketing rule: a whole panel or scene sliding in.

tokens.name: dur-scan
tokens.usage: Hero scan cycle (auth-hero-scan): fade in to 14%, hold to 82%, fade out.

tokens.name: dur-scan-short
tokens.usage: Marketing rule: the same scan cycle compressed for video beats and GIFs.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: App standard curve. Use for every enter and move.

tokens.name: ease-scan
tokens.usage: Scan tile opacity cycle only.

veil.note: The hero veil: veil colour at these opacities, left to right. Copy sits on the dark end.

tokens.name: veil-0
tokens.usage: Opacity at 0% width.

tokens.name: veil-28
tokens.usage: Opacity at 28% width.

tokens.name: veil-52
tokens.usage: Opacity at 52% width.

tokens.name: veil-78
tokens.usage: Opacity at 78% width; clear after that.

stroke.note: Line weights follow the isometric phone on verstack.ai: proportional to the drawing's size on screen (0.3% of its longer side, between 1.7 and 2.8 px at 1080p), with the outer contour heavier than the lines inside it. Values below are typical at 1080p.

tokens.name: stroke-contour
tokens.usage: The outer contour of a solid (its silhouette). The heaviest line in a drawing.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Every other outline in a drawing: about 0.62 of the contour.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Secondary detail (fins, rugs, door swings) in fg-subtle: about half the contour.

tokens.name: corner-round
tokens.usage: Corner radius of appliance boxes, in drawing units (an appliance is about 6 wide). Buildings, plans and ladders stay square.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: The dot in a dot label.

frame.note: Video and motion frame. Imagery only: a card (or a bento of cards) on the dark ground, the drawing or app screen centred in each card. Light mode: mist cards, ink lines. Dark mode: card-dark cards, mist lines.

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Dark ground showing around and between cards.

tokens.name: card-radius
tokens.usage: Light card corner at 1920 x 1080. Scales with the frame's short side (40/1080).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Imagery fills this share of its card's short side, centred both ways.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Lime ring around one real app element, with a 1.5px ink line inside.

tokens.name: sweep
tokens.usage: Scan-gradient sweep opacity. One clip in the library uses it; never as a cut.

tokens.name: card-dark
tokens.usage: Dark mode card (the website's scene-dark). Lines on it are mist; the lime part's outline turns this colour.

tokens.name: card-dark-edge
tokens.usage: 1 px inner edge on a dark mode card, so cards read on the dark ground.
